population.description: Adults with restricted or low-variety diets

gradeRationale.note: Directness is INDIRECT: the measured outcome is intake adequacy, not health. That is exactly why the eligibility rule is diet-gated and the ceiling is 'potentially useful'.

statement: A broad-spectrum multivitamin raises measured micronutrient intake in people whose diets are restricted or low in variety; whether that translates into clinical benefit in an otherwise healthy adult is not established.
